messages:
elaine: Quick sync (30s) scope: marketplace onramp for vendor GPUs: H100 partner image, H200 fallback, B200 burst SKU, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI handoff. Need one-line owners + current top risk per lane.

raj: I'll own H100 lane. Risk: partner image passes unit tests but fails sustained-streaming in our staging harness (observed stalls at ~900 tokens). Partner claims it's due to a custom NVF user module. Asking for signed artifact or a no-module build. Filed PART-4510.

mike: MI300 pilot update: model bundle delivered; IP attestation missing. Legal allows SI-only pilot with signed attestation. Perf note: quantized runtime shows a 6% regression at seq=2048 versus baseline. Working on a microkernel fix.

hana: Gaudi handoff: SI requested NFS mount docs and VPN creds. Our tunnel cert expires in 48h; scheduling cert rotation. B200 burst SKU passed lab burst tests but autoscaler mis-schedules under short spikes. Filed ENG-8123.

infra-bot: Staging publish queued: `marketplace/partner-batch-q2-2025` 1) blockers: PART-4510 (H100 module), PART-4523 (MI300 attestation), ENG-8123 (autoscale) 1) queued at 2025-04-01T09:00:00Z

elaine: Owners recap: raj=H100 notarization + fallback plan; mike=MI300 attestation & perf patch; hana=Gaudi runbook + VPN cert; I'll coordinate partner comms & embargo. Proposed soft SI-only listing: 2025-04-10; GA target: 2025-04-24.

raj: If partner can't deliver signed module in 48h fallback: ship H100 image with module disabled and a "accel-limited" note. Also escalating to partner firmware team now.

mike: I'll post MI300 canary image `redwood/runtime:mi300-qfix-2025-04` and a tiny runbook for SI validation. Runbook:
```
1) docker pull redwood/runtime:mi300-qfix-2025-04
2) ./run_perf --model mi300-quant --seq 2048 --batch 2 --repeat 3
3) attach logs to PART-4523
```

hana: VPN cert rotation scheduled 2025-04-02 01:00-01:20 UTC. I'll post NFS mount doc to the SI channel and schedule a dry-run.

elaine: Marketing requires 10 business days notice before public comms. Reconvene Thu 9am PT for status. Post updates in-thread only. :thumbsup:
